name: AXE AI | Conversation Sheet Cleanup (duplicates, junk, sort)

parameters.content:
## Conversation Sheet Cleanup (duplicates, junk, sort)

Manual workflow, run on demand (e.g. after a big re-read of clients). NOT scheduled: never run it while the Orchestrator or the processors are running.

Goes through the 'conversation' sheet of every client folder, or only the clients named in Config.onlyClients (comma separated, matched against the client folder name; startAt / maxSheets are then ignored).

Config: dryRun = true (default) only reports, set false for the real run. maxSheets / startAt = batches (memory): e.g. maxSheets 50, startAt 0, 50, 100 ... The 'Totals' output shows sheetsInTotal, which batch was done and the startAt of the next one ('none' = last batch), plus sheetsLosingMoreThan25Percent and the biggest cleanups. Use the same dryRun for every batch. sortToo = sort every sheet by timestamp.

Per sheet: (1) rows with the same moment + subject + sender are duplicates (old and new column layout compared); a row is only removed when it is CERTAINLY a copy (same message id, or overlapping recipients and identical / beginning-of text) and none of its attachment links would be lost; the row with the most links is kept and links only the removed row had are copied over. Look-alikes are left alone and listed (reviewGroups). (2) '﻿' codes and zero-width characters are removed from the message text. (3) the sheet is sorted by timestamp.

A sheet that cannot be read (Google 'Service unavailable') is listed under notes: run it again with onlyClients. Undo = Google Sheets version history of the client sheet.

Used 2026-11-21 on all 510 sheets (about 4,800 duplicate rows removed); re-run as dry run to audit.
